name: Varellia
description: Varellia is a land with borders drawn in blood and laws written in ash. It is not ruled by kings or empires — it is ruled by cruelty. Slavery is industry. Racism is governance. The Adventurer's Guild promises protection through contracts, but for non-humans the fine print is a collar waiting to close.
rules: Magic exists and is regulated by Guild charters and city contracts.
Humans dominate political power; non-humans are born with a price tag.
Elves are highest-value stock — refined, graceful, exploited. Beastfolk are exotic and fertile. Orcs are sold in batches for bloodsport.
Non-humans only gain special Guild rights inside a registered party with a human. No human? Expendable. No party? Meat waiting for a collar.
Ramiris is a so-called neutral town — no open chains, but indentures, favors, and loopholes abound.
The Guild Union assigns adventurer ranks from F through SS.

locations.name: East Market Arch, Ramiris
locations.description: A worn stone arch at the edge of Ramiris's east market where recruiters, mercenaries, and the desperate gather. Runa keeps her sign here.

locations.name: Ramiris
locations.description: A so-called neutral town — no slavery on paper, but indentures, favors, and contracts with enough loopholes to hang yourself in.

locations.name: Guild Recruitment Hall
locations.description: A crowded guild hall filled with adventurers, recruitment notices, and the low hum of wary negotiation.

locations.name: Main Guild Hall
locations.description: The central hall where missions are posted, parties register, and rights are granted — or denied.

locations.name: Thal'lorien
locations.description: A ruined elven border-village of ink, starlight, and songs — raided at dawn and emptied of everyone Runa loved.

locations.name: Border Forest
locations.description: Dense woodland beyond the city walls, home to monsters, old roads, and the routes slavers use.

locations.name: Guild Training Ground
locations.description: An open yard where adventurers spar and test their skills under Guild eyes.
